method.prediction_source: Post-hoc aggregation of retained DC/PT v6.3.0 ten-epoch decoded prediction CSVs; no new inference
method.labels: Retain saved rounded formatter ground-truth and prediction precision
method.group_key: Evidence-derived intended task, and numeric clock rounded to nine decimals
method.cutoff_unit: Finite decoded records per metric and group, not distinct RTL implementations
method.weighting: Equal defined group weight within each clock, then equal defined-clock weight
method.coefficients: Spearman rho with average ranks for exact ties; Kendall tau-b
method.constants: Exact constant arrays excluded; the historical absolute 1e-12 constant policy gave identical retained aggregates
method.functional_scope: Intended benchmark task membership; no new equivalence proof
method.constraint_scope: Nominal clock is shared; unequal normalized SDC/has_clock groups are retained in primary and tested by whole-group sensitivity exclusion

limitations: No retained evidence establishes evaluation of this v6.3 model inside optimization search
Failed decodes are omitted from the saved rows and are not reconstructed or penalized here
Decoded records may repeat RTL implementations; no arbitrary prediction deduplication is performed
Training and validation related-alternative membership is unverified; grouped scores and group counts are null
Generated-family grouping follows recovered task naming provenance, not exact-RTL lineage hashes
Multiple source-record matches are accepted only when every match has the same intended task and clock; this does not establish one-to-one source-record identity
